narration.text: God did not hang that rainbow because Noah was perfect, and the story says so plainly.
He failed again, the way people do. Still, God hung up His own bow.
Before any rainbow, Noah did one thing first on dry ground, and it still stops me every time. Watch what it was.

title: God Did Not Hang That Rainbow Because Noah Was Perfect | Noah, Genesis 8-9 (KJV) #shorts
description:
The Keeper over the waiting of the flood: God remembered Noah, and mercy was never Noah's reward, it was God's idea (Genesis 8-9, King James Version).

Watch the full story, the whole of Genesis 8-9: https://youtu.be/1m-NUJhkdMY

Scripture: King James Version (public domain), Genesis 8:1-3; 9:12-17. The reflection is the Keeper's own words, marked apart from scripture.
Visuals: AI-generated scenes (Buzzy, GPT-image stills with camera motion). Narration: AI voice. Music: original, owned.

issues: 00:00 to 00:16 The top half is one slow-moving still of the ark on the sea for 16.2 s (s-fountains), then one still of a figure at a fire for 7.8 s (s-lines): 2 shots in 24 s, one scene change. No rainbow on top while the lines speak of one. Low visual variety; the long's own shots are 15-23 s each, so no unused sentence-safe 23.4-24.1 s window has more shots.

00:06 and 00:12 The whole mix is silent for 1.32 s (6.07-7.39) and 0.87 s (11.88-12.75) between the three Keeper clips (the top clip is muted and our line ends before each clip's picture does): the local review flags them as dropouts; they read as pauses between thoughts, but the mouth keeps a small movement over part of that silence.
00:00 The local review flags speech at the first frame (a); the first word starts at the clip's own 0.3 s offset, unchanged from the earlier render.

Voice is OUR Kokoro line on the stored Pavo picture (E287, remux run 41654835246, digest proof on the kept bytes); sync was measured strictly on that audio (SyncNet offset 0/-1, confidence 6.6/5.0/7.2). The render slowed the three clips x0.92 (E286, atempo with the picture slowed equally, so sync holds); heard pace 164.2 wpm, at the top of the 115-165 band. Sync AFTER the retime was not re-measured (only the unslowed clips were).

Audio was NOT heard by ear. The pinned ASR (local-review 41661153948) hears exactly the three lines (52 words) and nothing else; -14.2 LUFS, -1.9 dBTP. Delivery, diction and the sound of the retimed voice are not claimed.
